limitations: 48 deterministic fixtures, not a new Monte Carlo acceptance claim.
32 added darts and 16 moving-shadow-only pairs; 8 repeated fixed targets.
Shadows are neutral multiplicative board-plane attenuation, 12 sampled light points, with 14–30% source strengths and a high ambient floor.
No coloured-light reflections, dart self-shading, people or camera movement within an event.
HSV/RGB tests and cross-view agreement can still confuse certain material changes with shadows. Real footage remains necessary.
fixture_design: Eight fixed accepted mixed-stress pose/target setups repeated across four lighting/material conditions; plus sixteen moving-shadow-only pairs. Foreground evaluation, no calibration refit.
